message.content:
Here’s a mix of classic, modern, and niche horror films that have earned a reputation for being genuinely scary (or at least unsettling). Pick whatever fits your mood!

| # | Title | Year | Why it’s worth watching |
|---|-------|------|------------------------|
| 1 | **The Shining** | 1980 | Stanley Kubrick’s masterful psychological horror, with a chilling atmosphere and iconic performances. |
| 2 | **Hereditary** | 2018 | A disturbing family drama that escalates into supernatural terror; the score and cinematography are unforgettable. |
| 3 | **Get Out** | 2017 | A smart, socially conscious thriller that blends horror with sharp satire. |
| 4 | **The Babadook** | 2014 | A psychological horror about grief that turns into a literal monster; very atmospheric. |
| 5 | **A Quiet Place** | 2018 | Suspense built around silence; the stakes feel real and the tension never lets up. |
| 6 | **It Follows** | 2014 | A fresh take on the “invisible stalker” trope, with a creepy, relentless vibe. |
| 7 | **Midsommar** | 2019 | A daylight horror that’s as unsettling as it is beautiful; the cult setting is unnerving. |
| 8 | **The Conjuring** | 2013 | A modern classic of haunted house horror, with solid scares and a strong narrative. |
| 9 | **The Ring** | 2002 | A remake of the Japanese original that still delivers a chilling, slow‑burn dread. |
|10 | **The Exorcist** | 1973 | The quintessential exorcism film; its psychological terror still feels fresh. |
|11 | **Paranormal Activity** | 2007 | Low‑budget found‑footage style that makes the supernatural feel immediate. |
|12 | **The Witch** | 2015 | A period horror that uses isolation and folklore to build dread. |
|13 | **Suspiria** (2018) | 2018 | Luca Guadagnino’s remake of the 1977 classic; it’s visually striking and deeply unsettling. |
|14 | **The Others** | 2001 | A gothic psychological thriller with a twist that keeps you guessing. |
|15 | **The Cabin in the Woods** | 2012 | A meta‑take on horror tropes that’s both funny and genuinely scary. |

Feel free to pick a few from different eras or sub‑genres—there’s something here whether you’re into supernatural hauntings, psychological dread, or visceral gore. Enjoy the chills!
